title: Structural characterization and immunomodulatory activity of a glycogen from Meretrix lyrata.
authors: Li, Siru; Fu, Fangcheng; Zhang, Dawei; Yu, Qian; Yan, Chunyan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究贝类糖原的结构表征与免疫调节活性，涉及多糖与TLR4蛋白的分子对接，但对象为糖类-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Marine shellfish are not only important food ingredients in human diets, but also their tissues contain polysaccharides with significant bioactivities and pharmacological effects. In this study, a glucan (MLP60-1) was successfully isolated from the soft tissue of Meretrix lyrata. Structural characterization through monosaccharide compositions, methylation analysis, acid and enzymatic hydrolysis, mass spectrometry, and nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy suggested that MLP60-1 is a highly branched glycogen defined by a branching frequency of approximately one branch per 3.3 glucose residues. The backbone of MLP60-1 consists of -->4)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1--> residue, with branches substituted at the C-6 position comprising -->4,6)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->, alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->, -->6)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->, and -->4)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1--> residues. Subsequently, in vitro immunomodulatory assays indicated that MLP60-1 significantly enhanced nitric oxide (12.5 mug/mL, p < 0.05) and reactive oxygen species production and stimulated the secretion of tumor necrosis factor-alpha, interleukin-6, and interleukin-1beta in RAW264.7 cells. The molecular mechanism study was demonstrated that MLP60-1 promotes macrophage activation via the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Subcellular localization of fluorescently labeled derivatives, siRNA interference, microscale thermophoresis assay (K(d) = 9.89 +/- 1.50 mumol/L), and molecular docking analysis further suggested TLR4 is likely to plays a potential crucial role as membrane protein target mediating MLP60-1-induced macrophage activation and immunoregulation. Collectively, these findings suggest that MLP60-1 exhibits potential immunomodulatory properties, which may support its future exploration as a natural functional food ingredient.
abstract_zh: 海洋贝类不仅是人类饮食中的重要食材，其组织还含有具有显著生物活性和药理作用的多糖。本研究从斧文蛤（Meretrix lyrata）的软组织中成功分离出一种葡聚糖（MLP60-1）。通过单糖组成、甲基化分析、酸和酶水解、质谱及核磁共振波谱的结构表征表明，MLP60-1是一种高度分支的糖原，其分支频率约为每3.3个葡萄糖残基一个分支。MLP60-1的主链由-->4)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->残基组成，在C-6位取代的分支包括-->4,6)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->、alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->、-->6)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->和-->4)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->残基。随后，体外免疫调节实验表明，MLP60-1显著增强了RAW264.7细胞中一氧化氮（12.5 μg/mL，p < 0.05）和活性氧的产生，并刺激了肿瘤坏死因子-α、白细胞介素-6和白细胞介素-1β的分泌。分子机制研究表明，MLP60-1通过TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB信号通路促进巨噬细胞活化。荧光标记衍生物的亚细胞定位、siRNA干扰、微量热泳动实验（K(d) = 9.89 ± 1.50 μmol/L）和分子对接分析进一步表明，TLR4可能作为膜蛋白靶点在介导MLP60-1诱导的巨噬细胞活化和免疫调节中发挥潜在关键作用。综合来看，这些发现表明MLP60-1具有潜在的免疫调节特性，这可能支持其未来作为天然功能性食品成分的探索。
